tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Get one pattern by number, including its complete transplantable HTML, CSS and JS. Pass framework to get a ready-to-use component wrapper (react .tsx, vue .vue, svelte .svelte, or vanilla .ts).

tools.name: get_kit
tools.description: Get the Motion Menu build kit: the design laws, the one-page act protocol, stack pins, known gotchas, and the full pattern index. Call this FIRST before building a page.

tools.name: get_design_digest
tools.description: Get the machine-readable Motion Menu quality contract. Call before build_page. It defines anti-generic composition rules, motion lifecycle, responsive requirements, truth constraints, and release verification gates.

tools.name: propose_directions
tools.description: Turn a business/page brief into three deliberately different design genomes before choosing components. Each direction defines layout grammar, typography, imagery, motion physics, density rhythm, and explicit avoid rules. Pass a returned direction_id into build_page with the same brief and seed.

tools.name: build_page
tools.description: Design a complete page from intent. Returns an act map — 5–7 acts in page order, each with a purpose, recommended patterns (by slug), and a density rating (loud/quiet). Follows the one-page protocol: density wave pacing, one GL spectacle, 12–18 viewport-heights. Feed the result straight to get_patte
